description: Allowlist for scripts/submit-ecosystem-prs.mjs. Copy to scripts/ecosystem-targets.json (gitignored), set example to false, and list only repositories you maintain. targets stays empty until then. The script does not search GitHub and does not open a pull request unless you pass --apply with that copied file.

targetShape.framework: langchain, langgraph, vercel-ai, openai-agents, llamaindex, or mastra
